item.title: Splat 1.0.18
item.description:
- **comrak 1.2.0.** Splat reads Markdown with comrak 1.2.0 and its fixes for the security advisory GHSA-7f8r-4rh5-vr5h: a document built to stall Splat with failing autolinks, long runs of `~~` or `==`, long `>` runs with alerts or chained attribute blocks no longer keeps it busy for minutes. A document with more than 500,000 empty table cells shows its tables as text. - **Formulas with backticks.** A formula with a backtick in it, imported from Word or another format, stays a formula instead of turning into code. - **Pictures in bold or italic text** keep both in the Word export.
Something wrong or missing? [Report it on GitHub](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/issues/new/choose).
